segments.title: Cold Open & Hart Audio Sponsor Read
segments.notes: Case Blackwell and Fiona troubleshoot stream setup; Hart Audio 'Cream Team' merch plug with promo code.

segments.title: Casual Desk Chat: Hawaii, Moving, Airbnb Horror Stories
segments.notes: Case, Fiona, and V discuss Hawaii nostalgia, Case's impending move and potential homelessness, and swap Airbnb nightmare anecdotes involving creepy owners and hidden cameras.

segments.title: Sex Tape Economics & Porn Industry Deep Dive
segments.notes: Extended discussion on celebrity sex tapes (Pamela Anderson, Tommy Lee, Kim Kardashian), male porn performer stamina standards, VR porn constraints, and Case's traumatic 'porn tour' party-bus experience in the Valley.

segments.title: Black History Month Pedagogy & Black Trauma in Media
segments.notes: Panel reacts to a viral classroom door decoration segregating students by race; Fiona recounts her fourth-grade 'underground railroad' camp simulation trauma; debate over slavery-film oversaturation vs. historical memory.

segments.title: Fiona Reads Black Twitter Roasts
segments.notes: Fiona performs a dramatic reading of a viral thread roasting a man's appearance ('Weenie Hut Juniors', 'SpongeBob when he turned normal').

segments.title: Trump Sneaker Con Debut & Fox News Spin Reaction
segments.notes: Panel watches Fox News clip claiming gold Trump sneakers connect with Black voters 'because they love sneakers'; unanimous derision of the racial essentialism and 'Pee-wee Herman' energy.

segments.title: Patreon Plug, Movie Night Planning & Hype Train 90s Hip-Hop Sub Rap
segments.notes: Case plugs Wednesday Patreon pod and potential Sunday movie night; Hype Train hijacks close-out with a multi-level freestyle rap over 90s hip-hop beats thanking sub/gift donors.

segments.title: Sign-Off & Raid
segments.notes: Case confirms streaming schedule for the week, mentions apartment move progress, and initiates raid.

characters.name: Case Blackwell
characters.notes: anchor. Hosts the Cream Team Dream Stream special with guests Fiona and V; plugs Hart Audio merch, Patreon, and upcoming movie night.

characters.name: Fiona
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Guest co-host; shares Airbnb horror stories, performs Black Twitter roast reading, and recounts childhood underground-railroad simulation trauma.

characters.name: V
characters.notes: in-studio contributor. Guest co-host; debates Black history pedagogy, critiques slavery-film industrial complex, and reacts to Trump sneaker discourse.

characters.name: Hype Train
characters.notes: recurring. Closes the broadcast with a multi-level 90s-hip-hop freestyle rap acknowledging subscriber and bit donations.

episode_summary: Case Blackwell hosts a special 'Cream Team Dream Stream' alongside guests Fiona and V, covering personal moving chaos, a legendary porn-tour disaster story, a searing critique of performative Black history month lessons, and a viral Black Twitter roast reading. The broadcast concludes with a Fox News clip dissection on Trump's gold sneakers and a Hype Train sub-reading rap finale.
